svg.title: Sovereign AI Standard — certificate SAS-2026-0007
svg.text: CERTIFICATE OF CERTIFICATION · ISSUED UNDER SOVEREIGN AI STANDARD V1.0
has been assessed by an accredited independent assessor and holds
against Sovereign AI Standard v1.0, Track A, across all seven dimensions of AI control.
LEVEL ACHIEVED PER DIMENSION · S1 MODEL · S2 DATA · S3 PROVENANCE · S4 OPERATIONAL · S5 INFRASTRUCTURE · S6 EXIT · S7 EVALUATION
Certification is product-scoped and evidences the published criteria at the level stated; it does not certify accuracy, safety, fairness or fitness for purpose.
The certificate is the Standard's record; its status is live on the public register. The field below is the V-Seal: it binds this face to its seed and to these results.
